Control study · Compliance data → living house record

The Product Passport Becomes the House Record

A product passport can become part of a house archive when verified compliance data is joined to provenance, care, repair, change, authorship, and stewardship without confusing mandatory fields with complete history.

Read the exhibition

00

The proposition

The EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation establishes a framework that includes digital product passports, with details dependent on delegated acts and implementation. That current legal source should not be reduced to a trend prediction or represented as a complete rule for every garment today. It does, however, make product-level information infrastructure central to a changing European regulatory landscape.

A house can treat the resulting data as more than a compliance endpoint. Stable identifiers, material and supply-chain evidence, care, repair, alteration, ownership or custody events where appropriate, rights, contributor records, and archival relationships can make an object more intelligible over time. The danger is equally institutional: false precision, unverifiable supplier claims, inaccessible interfaces, surveillance, proprietary lock-in, and data that disappears when a vendor closes.

01–04

The institutional sequence

01 · REQUIRE

What is legally required now?

Identify product scope, applicable delegated acts, actor, territory, date, required fields, carrier, access rules, and official legal source. Mark future implementation unresolved until adopted.

VERIFIEDS38

02 · VERIFY

Who supports each field?

Bind claim, data source, responsible party, verification method, date, confidence, correction, and evidence file. Do not transform a supplier assertion into an audited fact.

PROPOSALS34S38

03 · EXTEND

What history may responsibly be added?

Connect design development, maker and repair records, care, alterations, provenance, archive deposit, rights, and permitted owner narration while minimizing personal data.

INFERENCES08S39S42

04 · PRESERVE

Will the record survive the vendor?

Require export, open formats, persistent identifiers, versioning, backups, access governance, migration tests, and a non-digital fallback for essential care information.

PROPOSALS39S66

COUNTERPOINT

What this framework could get wrong

More product data does not automatically create accountability. A passport can amplify unverified claims, expose workers or consumers, shift burdens onto suppliers, and become inaccessible after sale. Evidence quality and governance matter more than interface polish.

FIELDWORK

Do the work now

Use this as a working session, not a score.

  1. Determine the product, territory, date, and authoritative requirements with counsel.
  2. Trace every proposed field to its source and verifier.
  3. Separate public, restricted, personal, confidential, and archival layers.
  4. Export and restore one record without the current software vendor.

PACKAGE SYSTEM

Finished platform treatments

01

LONG VIDEO — Place the regulation beside one object record, then build required, verified, optional, restricted, and archival layers.

02

SHORT 01 — “A QR code is not a provenance system.” Reveal the evidence behind each field.

03

SHORT 02 — “Future regulation is not present obligation.” Date and scope every legal statement.

04

CAROUSEL — Scope; law; identifier; field; source; verifier; privacy; repair; export; archive.

05

AUDIO — A product-record walkthrough that states which fields are fact, inference, planned, or legally unresolved.

06

BEEHIIV / LINKEDIN / INSTAGRAM / PINTEREST — Publish updated, date-stamped editions and revise whenever delegated requirements change.

Reading protocol

Every material statement carries an evidence label and point-of-claim source links. Interpretation is never presented as source fact. Legal sections identify their jurisdiction; state, foreign, contractual, beneficial-ownership, validity, priority, and disputed-fact questions remain counsel-review gates. This exhibition is educational and does not provide legal, conservation, or business advice.
